title: RepBench: Compiling Benchmarks into Capability Representations for Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2607.28008v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Representation engineering reads and steers capability directions in large language models, yet methods are typically evaluated on paper-specific synthetic data. The resulting measurements are difficult to compare or reproduce and may reflect surface patterns rather than capabilities. We present RepBench, a benchmark-grounded data layer for capability-aligned representation probing. Crawling 13,427 benchmark papers yields a taxonomy of 182 capability clusters in 13 families; harvesting 353 public benchmark datasets yields 46,149 audited probe texts covering 94 capabilities, each supported by at least two independent benchmarks. This multi-benchmark design reduces dependence on any single source: raw per-text vectors exhibit no natural cluster granularity, whereas benchmark-pooled capability vectors show an interior clustering optimum at a small number of clusters on all 12 evaluated models, with low agreement to the human taxon

translated_title: RepBench：将基准测试编译为大型语言模型的能力表示
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2607.28008v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：表示工程读取并引导大型语言模型中的能力方向，但方法通常基于论文特定的合成数据进行评估。由此产生的测量结果难以比较或复现，可能反映表面模式而非实际能力。我们提出了RepBench，一个基于基准测试的数据层，用于能力对齐的表示探测。通过爬取13,427篇基准论文，我们构建了一个包含13个家族、182个能力聚类的分类体系；收集353个公开基准数据集，得到46,149个经过审计的探测文本，覆盖94种能力，每种能力至少由两个独立基准支持。这种多基准设计减少了对单一来源的依赖：原始逐文本向量未显示出自然聚类粒度，而基准池化的能力向量在所有12个评估模型上表现出内部聚类最优，且与人类分类的一致性较低。
tldr: RepBench 通过整合多基准数据构建能力表示，提供了一种更可靠、可复现的大型语言模型能力探测方法。
en_tdlr: RepBench constructs capability representations by integrating multi-benchmark data, offering a more reliable and reproducible approach for probing large language model capabilities.
